overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Utility Committee was scheduled to meet to address infrastructure and operational matters including a water tower lease renewal, septic tank review, and consideration of a data center ordinance.

agenda.item: Director of Public Works and Utilities Report

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action regarding the AT&T water tower lease. This item was listed under old business, indicating it was a continuing matter from a previous meeting.
The committee was scheduled to discuss and consider possible action on a septic tank review. Details regarding the scope or purpose of this review were not specified on the published agenda.

The committee was set to discuss and consider possible action on a data center ordinance. This new business item was expected to address regulatory or zoning matters related to data center operations in the village.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, with possible extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to consider action on AT&T Water Tower Lease
Scheduled to consider action on Septic Tank Review
Scheduled to consider action on Data Center Ordinance
title: Utility Committee Meeting - 2026-09-01
